experiments.name: Architecture red-team (hermes) — verdict: REPLACE B with A+
experiments.blurb: Convenience-is-not-an-argument mandate executed. The KV case for GDN hybrids collapses at 8-16K (weights traffic dominates; KV is 3-4 orders below it); llama.cpp hybrid prefix-cache reuse is broken today for exactly our PSM pattern (open #26994/#24785/#25913); sequential 3:1 is the worst hybrid shape for spec decode. Revised primary A+: vanilla dense GQA (2 KV heads), 32K R-regex-BPE tied vocab, MTP, Matryoshka tiers unified with LayerSkip early-exit, n-gram spec first. Falcon-H1-shape parallel hybrid = the one to watch. Six ordered kill-tests, first three ~1 week with zero training.
experiments.verdict: Full report: docs/research/arch-redteam-v1.md (616 lines, primary-source cited). Decision pending user review.

experiments.name: GLM-5.3 post-training read-out
experiments.blurb: Digested z.ai's GLM-5.3 story for our future RL phase. Headline: same base as 5.2, ALL gains from scaling post-training environments+RL. Transferables adopted: (1) environments plug in as DATA on one dataflow (our cases library is exactly this shape), (2) synthesized verifiers gated three ways before use (oracle passes / no-op fails / unsolved fails) - our corrupted-twin rule, generalized, (3) solver trajectories hunt reward shortcuts before training on binary rewards, (4) engineer training-rollout logprob alignment (they hit 1e-7), (5) token efficiency IMPROVES with capability under RL - our no_op family is the SFT seed of that.
experiments.verdict: Logged to research notes. Bonus: their coding plan bills off-peak at 50% - our night burns are half-price; 98% cache-hit billing reinforces PSM prefix-cache design.

decisions: Suffix-completion convention everywhere: predict ONLY what comes after the cursor (user decision; finish-block re-emission retired).
Dropout conditioning is the production config — justified by robustness to prompt population, not type signal (ablation showed none).
Telemetry: local collection always, upload never — until an explicit opt-in (off by default).
Eval battery: acceptance counters (extension) > validator-exact scenario families + calibrated judge + intent assertions > line-F1 midtyping (composition-blind, 4 datapoints).
Effort is never a blocker; llama.cpp support is deployment evidence, not selection criteria. Wide architecture space gets a genuine pass.
Quota discipline: max 6-8 concurrent zai consumers; Gemini (agy) and Opus 4.6 (separate quota) for free-tier generation; Opus reserved for high-judgment tasks.
Ops: llama-server evals CPU-only; readiness via POST /v1/completions (never /health); kill by tracked PID/port only; GPU jobs strictly sequential (flock, not memory polls — the 03:20 incident).
